Resolves #19303

A drag whose pressed node a re-render replaced inside the sensor's 100 ms start delay now reaches the App. Before, `DragDrop#onDragStart` measured `event.target` and resolved the zone from the dispatch path. `sensor.Base#trigger` dispatches on `document` once the pressed node is detached, so the start threw on `document.getBoundingClientRect()`. The sensor then went on "dragging" a gesture no zone owned. Now `resolveSensorPath` takes the press's own path from `detail` when the dispatch path begins at `document`, and each replaced node answers through the connected node carrying its id. `resolvePressedElement` measures that successor for the main-thread offsets. A press on a connected node keeps the dispatch target and its live ancestors.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms plus two mutations) and L3 in a real headless browser, run on the #19288 branch plus this fix (details under Test Evidence). No residual on this close target. The arm's remaining failure was a different layer, #19285's focused-tab churn, which #19294 has since fixed (see Deltas).

size-guard-growth: src/main/addon/DragDrop.mjs — two resolution helpers for the sensor's documented `detail` contract; the two call sites change in place, and no consumer lines exist to delete

## Deltas from ticket
AC-3 was amended on the ticket after measurement. The start is now delivered on every run. On some runs the press re-renders the tab header and no connected successor exists at the start, so the App sizes the proxy from an empty rect: 2 px against 48. That layer is #19285's focused-tab churn (the Overflow projection withholding the focused tab), not the screen flag #19288 carries. With #19294's Overflow diff applied on top of this fix, the arm went 8/8 isolated and 2/2 whole-file with no header removals (2026-09-26); #19294 has merged as a50ae57ce8. Waiting for the header to be stable before pressing made it worse (2/8), so the press itself triggers the re-render.

## Test Evidence
- Mutations (unit): putting back the old `onDragStart` reads turns the new document arm red. Putting back `getEventData`'s dispatch path turns it red on the path ids. Dropping the successor mapping turns it red on `isConnected`. All reverted.
- e2e, `WorkstationDragAffordancesNL` › "the ordinary body-mounted tab proxy…", 1920×1080 flag:
  - before the fix: 0/3 isolated and 0/2 whole-file, every failure the page error with the start lost.
  - with the fix: 14 isolated and 5 whole-file runs. `getBoundingClientRect is not a function` appears in none. Every run gets past the start. 13 pass; 5 fail on the proxy width (the #19285 layer), 1 on a Neural Link bridge disconnect.
  - These e2e runs used this diff before its rebase onto #19301, which merged Escape handling into the same file (other methods). The rebased head passes the unit subsets for `main`, `draggable`, `dashboard` and `manager`.
